newsitem.title: JAPAN: GKN applies to delist from Tokyo bourse.
newsitem.headline: GKN applies to delist from Tokyo bourse.

text.p: Britain's GKN Plc said on Thursday that it had applied to the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) to delist its shares from the Tokyo bourse.
GKN said in a statement that it had decided to delist as the number of its shares held and traded in the Tokyo market had fallen to very low levels.
It also said that the cost of the listing was "disproportionately high".
The company did not say when its shares, which were listed on the foreign section of the TSE in December 1988, would actually be delisted from the exchange.
